quote.text: From Claudius Maximus, in all things to endeavour to have power of myself, and in nothing to be carried about; to be cheerful and courageous in all sudden chances and accidents, as in sicknesses: to love mildness, and moderation, and gravity: and to do my business, whatsoever it be, thoroughly, and without querulousness. Whatsoever he said, all men believed him that as he spake, so he thought, and whatsoever he did, that he did it with a good intent. His manner was, never to wonder at anything; never to be in haste, and yet never slow: nor to be perplexed, or dejected, or at any time unseemly, or excessively to laugh: nor to be angry, or suspicious, but ever ready to do good, and to forgive, and to speak truth; and all this, as one that seemed rather of himself to have been straight and right, than ever to have been rectified or redressed; neither was there any man that ever thought himself undervalued by him, or that could find in his heart, to think himself a better man than he. He would also be very pleasant and gracious.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Model self-mastery: Strive to regulate your own emotions and reactions so that you set a calm, even-tempered example for your children during both ordinary days and unexpected challenges.
    • Nurture resilience: Encourage a spirit of cheerfulness and courage in the face of life's accidents and setbacks, helping your children learn to face difficulties with mildness and moderation.
  • Leadership
    • Lead by example: Just as one’s actions and words are perceived as an authentic reflection of their inner state, cultivate a manner that is steady, unruffled, and encouraging, thereby inspiring genuine trust and respect from your team.
    • Embrace the virtues of moderation and forgiveness: In leadership, avoid hasty judgments and temper your impulses with care, ensuring that every decision is made with a clear, honest intent and a readiness to support and forgive.
  • Product Management
    • Commit to thoroughness: Approach every task, project, or product feature with complete attention and diligence, ensuring that your work is done thoroughly and with genuine care, setting a high standard for quality.
    • Maintain composure under pressure: Just as the quote advises against being carried away by emotions, maintain a balanced perspective—even in high-pressure situations—to foster clear thinking and steady progress in product development.
